document: H0B hypothesis diff: original sentence, P07 ontology drift, 02 verdict, H0B revision
policy: 05 §1.1 and §H0B: the original hypothesis, manipulations, controls, falsification criterion, result categories, replicate count and parameter dependencies are preserved verbatim beside their frozen card SHA-256; the revision is recorded as a new overlay entry, never by rewriting the card.

cards.original_hypothesis: consecutive consumption improvement raises the political cost of a later welfare/real-income cut nonlinearly, so an equal cut provokes a larger response after a long improvement run than early in the window.
cards.p07_ontology_drift: Welfare provision cuts force households to increase forced saving, reducing consumption. The mechanism operates through the household budget constraint, not through price channels.
cards.h0b_revision: H0B keeps the card's dependent variable as the physical consumption volume per commodity (national_accounts.household_consumption, commodity 1960 unit) and marks the two 0-row columns (opposition grievance, policy welfare provision) as empty-table observations. The ratchet itself is NOT_RUN: it needs a matched-reference design, and no first-stage or political measurability exists yet.
original_manipulated_variables: policy.welfare_provision one-shot cut of equal size applied at 1961Q1 vs 1967Q1
policy.consumer_import_factor as a second real-income lever
original_controlled_variables: external history and the intervention files
cards.original_falsification_criterion: the late cut's response in the grievance/consumption metrics is not larger than the early cut's by the declared margin.

cards.original_hypothesis: soft budget plus investment hunger is sufficient to sustain systemic shortage independently of the demand regime.
cards.p07_ontology_drift: Hard budget constraints expose enterprise bottleneck constraints, generating tick diagnostics signals (queue buildup, demand overhang). The mechanism is activated when `policy.budget_hardness` increases.
cards.h0b_revision: H0B keeps the shortage counters (bottleneck_demand_count) and BLOCKS the undelivered *share* (no declared denominator), the credit_drawn/shortage_expectation composite (separator undeclared) and commodity_circuit.stock_close (no producer). The card's sufficiency claim ('independently of the demand regime') is not tested by H0B.
cards.original_falsification_criterion: with hardness raised and credit cut, the shortage metrics do not fall.

cards.original_hypothesis: full employment weakens enterprise discipline and feeds wage/hoarding feedback.
cards.p07_ontology_drift: Enterprise autonomy increases wage drift, triggering a wage-price spiral. The mechanism operates through `policy.wage_factor` and `policy.plan_utilization`.
cards.h0b_revision: All three card metrics are BLOCKED: the labour_mean/wage_arrears_sum composite cannot be truncated, production per worker has no comparable worker denominator, and household desired has no household-specific delivered counterpart. Historical support is BLOCKED until an independent labour hours/absence state exists.
cards.original_falsification_criterion: a wage-factor raise does not increase labour hoarding/arrears or reduce discipline metrics.

cards.original_hypothesis: the second economy is net stabilising or net eroding for the formal system.
cards.p07_ontology_drift: Consumer import factor caps force domestic substitution, reducing import volumes. The mechanism operates through `policy.consumer_import_factor`.
cards.h0b_revision: H0B keeps the card's subject (second economy) and refuses the import-compression reframing: the formal availability gap is bound to the physical unmet quantity, not to a monetary budget, service use is bound to a code-grounded value unit, and both plot composites stay BLOCKED until the F2 second-economy axes are declared.
cards.original_falsification_criterion: tolerance changes move neither the household availability gap nor the formal sector's delivery metrics.

cards.original_hypothesis: enterprise autonomy rising while soft-budget constraints persist produces efficiency gains and macro imbalance simultaneously.
cards.p07_ontology_drift: Enterprise autonomy amplifies bottleneck propagation: autonomous enterprises chase inputs more aggressively, worsening queue dynamics. Shares signals with M02 but the causal direction differs.
cards.h0b_revision: H0B keeps the shared bottleneck counter and BLOCKS both two-outcome composites (investment_approved/credit_drawn, production/used), and blocks money_stock.money_total_close (no sidecar; account consolidation undeclared). A counter shared with M2 is not an independent identification of M5.
cards.original_falsification_criterion: autonomy raises do not change the efficiency proxy without also changing the imbalance proxy (or vice versa).

cards.original_hypothesis: external debt lengthens the social contract and shifts its cost forward.
cards.p07_ontology_drift: Credit envelope tightening tightens borrowing constraints, reducing investment and amplifying output drops. The mechanism operates through `policy.credit_fraction`.
cards.reconciliation_decision: 外债被替换成国内信用
cards.h0b_revision: H0B keeps the physical household consumption volume and BLOCKS the channel-split imports composite, the money_stock credit/principal composite and treasury_cash (no account_label/currency selector). Domestic credit is not external debt, so X06 is registered as a new subject rather than as M6.
cards.original_falsification_criterion: additional borrowing does not defer the consumption/treasury deterioration.

cards.original_hypothesis: uneven distribution of social-contract gains across Budapest, the industrial belt and the agricultural counties creates different stability paths.
cards.p07_ontology_drift: Second economy tolerance policy (`policy.second_economy_tolerance`) shifts labor allocation between formal and informal sectors. The mechanism is detected through changes in `stage_balances` composition.
cards.h0b_revision: Both card metrics are BLOCKED: they name region axes, not measures, and opposition_regions carries 0 rows in a C0-style run. A national policy scalar is not a 20-region vector, and the plot-labour subject is registered as M4-S1 instead of taking the M7 number.
original_manipulated_variables: regional allocation via policy.investment_intensity plus policy.housing_factor
the 20 historical regions are the observation axis
cards.original_falsification_criterion: regional dispersion of the delivery/consumption metrics does not respond to the regional allocation levers.

cards.original_hypothesis: economic deterioration strengthens administrative conservatism under some conditions and the reform coalition under others.
cards.p07_ontology_drift: Private sector autonomy (`policy.private_autonomy`) drives productivity differences through competition dynamics. The mechanism operates through `organization_diagnostics` and `financial_accounts`.
cards.h0b_revision: H0B keeps policy_decisions.utility (0 rows in a C0-style run) and BLOCKS the mode-weights plus selected_candidate composite. Private-autonomy competition is registered as X08, a new subject.
original_manipulated_variables: the fork's coalition_weights and the reported feature path (via the 1968 arms)
cards.original_falsification_criterion: coalition weights do not switch modes under the declared deterioration path.

cards.original_hypothesis: stronger statistical/computational/feedback capacity removes a measurable share of shortage and planning error.
cards.p07_ontology_drift: Technology/forecast accuracy changes (`information_quarters.forecast_accuracy`) affect plan utilization and price stability. The mechanism operates through information asymmetry channels.
cards.reconciliation_decision: 部分主题一致但测量循环
cards.h0b_revision: H0B keeps policy_decisions.binding_constraints and the shortage count, and BLOCKS the four-column information composite: information_quarters.forecast_accuracy is a capability definition in the engine, not a realized forecast residual, so the research question needs issued/realized pairs before it can be answered.
cards.original_falsification_criterion: capability/investment raises do not reduce latency/error or the shortage metrics.

cards.original_hypothesis: subsidies, borrowing and CMEA terms postpone an external shock, and the postponement raises later fragility.
cards.p07_ontology_drift: Department-level planning friction (`departments.department_output`) generates systemic misallocation. The mechanism is detected through cross-department output variance.
cards.h0b_revision: All four card metrics are BLOCKED: the channel-split trade composite needs six columns, money_stock.money_total_close has no producer, treasury_cash has no account/currency selector, and the later window was never pre-registered. Departmental planning friction is registered as X10.
cards.original_falsification_criterion: the absorption arms do not differ in the size or timing of the postponement.

cards.original_hypothesis: continued investment and input priority for Department I crowds out Department II through raw-material, capital-good and labour competition, raising assortment shortage, durable waiting, forced substitution and the social-contract gap even when aggregate output grows.
cards.p07_ontology_drift: Policy interventions shift the composition of stage_balances (Inputs → Processing → Outputs). The mechanism operates through the material balance accounting system.
cards.reconciliation_decision: 机制被缩成会计恒等变化
cards.h0b_revision: H0B keeps the physical consumer-goods volume per commodity and BLOCKS the five composite/axis-only items; stage_balances is a per-stage long table and cannot be read as a Department I/II split without a two-department mapping the model does not declare.
cards.original_falsification_criterion: raising I-priority does not shift the department split or worsen the four consumer-side dimensions while output is held up.
